LanguageData.DTO_EnableAiPlanningTooltip: Allow the configured LLM provider to run once a provider is connected. When no provider is connected, the AI comp stays silent.
LanguageData.DTO_DebugLoggingTooltip: Write tool calls, selected incidents, and rejection reasons to the RimWorld log.
LanguageData.DTO_EnableWebSearchTooltip: Expose a public web search tool to Orca chat. Current local provider is Tavily and search queries are sent outside the game.
LanguageData.DTO_WebSearchProviderTooltip: Current implementation exposes Tavily as a function tool. Future model adapters can use provider-native search instead.
LanguageData.DTO_TavilyApiKeyTooltip: Required only when Orca web search is enabled. Stored in RimWorld mod settings.
LanguageData.DTO_WebSearchNativeReserved: Reserved: provider-native web search can be enabled later for model adapters that support their own hosted search tool.
LanguageData.DTO_EnableHttpMcpTooltip: Expose tools from one player-configured HTTP MCP server to Orca chat. This mod does not provide MCP tools by itself.
LanguageData.DTO_HttpMcpUrlTooltip: For example http://127.0.0.1:3333/mcp. Prefer local endpoints you control.
LanguageData.DTO_HttpMcpBearerTokenTooltip: Optional. Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header when not empty.
LanguageData.DTO_HttpMcpNote: MCP tools are discovered from configured servers and exposed to Orca chat with an mcp_ prefix. If more than one server is enabled, exposed tool names include the server name. Use only servers you trust.
LanguageData.DTO_ApiProviderTooltip: Click to cycle providers. Built-in presets use official DeepSeek and OpenAI endpoints. Use Custom for third-party OpenAI-compatible APIs such as OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, or local servers.
LanguageData.DTO_CustomBaseUrlTooltip: Base URL for a third-party or local OpenAI-compatible API, for example http://localhost:1234/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, or https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1. Only use providers you trust.
LanguageData.DTO_ApiKeyTooltip: Stored in RimWorld mod settings. The offline base storyteller does not send requests.
LanguageData.DTO_OpenAiOrganizationTooltip: Optional. Use only if your OpenAI account or legacy key requires a specific organization.
LanguageData.DTO_OpenAiProjectTooltip: Optional. Use only if you need to force requests into a specific OpenAI project.
LanguageData.DTO_ApiProxyUrlTooltip: Optional. Example: http://127.0.0.1:7890. Leave empty to use the system/default network path. SOCKS proxies are not supported here unless your proxy exposes an HTTP port.
LanguageData.DTO_ModelFallbackTooltip: Used when a role-specific model is empty. This is not the controller model.
LanguageData.DTO_ModelControllerTooltip: Optional. Routes each Orca chat turn to dialogue, tool, vision, or web-search specialists before the specialist model replies.
LanguageData.DTO_ModelDecisionTooltip: Used by the automatic storyteller planner that chooses incidents.
LanguageData.DTO_ModelDialogueTooltip: Used for Orca chat replies and memory compression.
LanguageData.DTO_ModelToolTooltip: Optional. When set, Orca chat uses this model for the first tool-capable pass, then the dialogue model after tool results.
LanguageData.DTO_ModelVisionTooltip: Reserved for future image-recognition tools. Empty means fall back to the fallback model.
LanguageData.DTO_ModelWebSearchTooltip: Reserved for future provider-native web search. Current Tavily search remains a local tool.
LanguageData.DTO_ModelNoDiscoveredModels: No discovered models. Configure an API key and wait for model discovery.
LanguageData.DTO_StorytellerAppearanceNote: These values are saved in RimWorld mod settings and applied to the Deepseek The Orca storyteller at runtime. Portrait paths start at the merged Textures root, for example Orca/Orca or AnotherMod/Portraits/Foo.
LanguageData.DTO_StorytellerPortraitFolderTooltip: Legacy field. New personas should use full portrait paths from the merged Textures root.
LanguageData.DTO_StorytellerPortraitNameTooltip: Legacy field. New personas should use full portrait paths without file extensions.
LanguageData.DTO_DefaultOrcaStorytellerDescription: Orca is an AI agent whose storytelling rhythm is like the ocean: sometimes calm, sometimes fierce. Orca calmly observes the colony's story, giving challenges and rewards when she thinks the moment is right.
LanguageData.DTO_ChatPersonaTooltip: Select the persona profile used by the dialogue model and storyteller appearance. Built-in Orca is hardcoded and read-only; custom personas are stored under the RimWorld config folder.
LanguageData.DTO_ChatPersonaFormatNote: Local persona files use XML and include persona prompt, storyteller name, storyteller description, and portrait texture paths.
LanguageData.DTO_SkillManagerDescription: Manage optional skill modules. Enabled skills add focused instructions to chat prompts and routing hints to the controller model.
LanguageData.DTO_SkillFormatNote: Local skills are folders containing SKILL.md. Submods can provide Skills/*/SKILL.md or OrcaSkills/*/SKILL.md folders. Context tags and trigger hints decide when a skill is injected. Text files under references/ are searched and injected only when relevant.
LanguageData.DTO_PluginManagerDescription: Manage optional agent modules. Plugins can add prompt context, response schema requirements, tool behavior, or runtime state.
LanguageData.DTO_PluginManagerFutureNote: Future agent plugins will appear in this manager instead of being mixed into model or tool settings.
LanguageData.DTO_MoodPluginDescription: Adds an internal mood value to Orca dialogue and lets the model return moodDelta with each reply.
LanguageData.DTO_MoodPluginDetails: When enabled, Orca chat receives mood state, replies must include moodDelta, and mood can affect event execution willingness. When disabled, replies only need a reply field and execution tools are not randomly refused because of mood.
LanguageData.DTO_EnableMoodPluginTooltip: Inject Orca mood state into dialogue, ask the model for moodDelta, and let mood affect event willingness.
LanguageData.DTO_MoodPluginNote: When disabled, Orca chat does not receive mood state, replies only need a reply field, and execution tools are not randomly refused because of mood.
LanguageData.DTO_ProactivePluginDescription: Lets Orca speak proactively about colony observations and RimTalk player-initiated conversations.
LanguageData.DTO_ProactivePluginDetails: Storyteller events selected by Orca still trigger proactive dialogue separately. These settings only affect ambient observations: new letters, colony state changes, and RimTalk records. Letters and colony state changes are merged into one colony observation stream.
LanguageData.DTO_EnableAmbientProactiveDialogueToolti: When disabled, only Orca-selected storyteller events can trigger proactive dialogue automatically.
LanguageData.DTO_ProactivePluginSettingsNote: Defaults: colony observations 0.25, RimTalk 0.15 plus 0.05 per miss, forced after 8 misses.
LanguageData.DTO_RimtalkProactiveUnavailable: RimTalk is not active, so RimTalk proactive trigger settings are hidden.
LanguageData.DTO_DebugPlanningDisabled: planning disabled or API key missing
LanguageData.DTO_OrcaChatNote: Floating chat; can read tools and trigger incidents on request.
LanguageData.DTO_OrcaChatLogEmpty: No Orca chat request has been recorded yet.
LanguageData.DTO_OrcaChatPromptLocation: Persona prompt is currently hardcoded in OrcaChatSession.EnsureSystemPrompt in OrcaChatWindow.cs. It is intentionally separate from the storyteller planner prompt.
LanguageData.DTO_OfflineNote: Offline behavior: the AI decision layer returns immediately. Story events are generated only by the XML-defined vanilla storyteller comps until an LLM provider is connected.
